title: Killacai 3D - A passion retro-revival solo dev game created in a single year.
author: Onye_Nacho
selftext:
Now granted as a disclosure, most of this game is NOT AI-generated. All of the art, programming, and sound effects are originally manually made; 

* I have created the artwork (almost singlehandedly, borrowing other assets from Sketchfab)
* I have programmed the entire game (singlehandedly).
* I have salvaged sound effects from old retro games (which many of them are itself stock audio effects anyway) and freesound.org.

**HOWEVER**, the sole AIG element here is the voice acting, using Eleven Labs back in 2023.

There is just no way I will ever trust/recruit anyone for talents after the cancel culture nightmare I suffered in the 2010s, and now especially that of this decade. I just usually take my time making a game I want to play and use whatever free and available content is possible - just like how it was in the 2000s with developing free games.

Anyways, Killacai 3D is \~8-12 hours long (or 16 hours if you include the unlockable Special Ops Missions) and its a fun fast-paced shoot-em'-up arcade game - all for the price of **free**.

It is also based on an old concept from an unreleased game my distant relative was working on during the 1990s before he ultimately scrapped it. He's no longer alive unfortunately, so I took it upon myself to reincarnate his original vision with the [Tour of Generations](https://qore.world/2024/11/01/introducing-the-tour-of-generations/) digital museum project. You can check it out if you wanna see the other games I've made to represent the gaming generations.

Finally, for anyone here who thinks AIG voices are a problem, just mute/zero-down the dialog volume and you're good to go.
